title: Warframe: Tau sets the date for release and reveals even more in new devstrean
summary: Warframe: Tau, the newest upcoming expansion to the hit hack-and-slash action game Warframe, is set to be its biggest since Warframe: 1999. Coming packed with new social hubs, a new warframe and more, developer Digital Extremes have revealed even more in their latest devstream, including a December 9th release date. Of course, for many of you, the headlining addition being showcased is the newest warframe joining the game's already expansive roster. Kullervo Prime boasts high-damage, high-risk manoeuvres and arrives alongside the Rauta Prime heavy shotgun and Victrica Prime heavy blade, two great new weapons to add to your arsenal. ... [MORE]

title: Ironclad: Battle Tank is a top-down tank-busting roguelike coming to Android
summary: What do you do when all hope seems lost, and you're the only one left? Well, clearly you go all out in your tracked war machine and hope to take the enemy down before they do the same to you! And that fast-paced, heavy metal experience is precisely what top-down tank sim Ironclad: Battle Tank promises to provide. Ironclad: Battle Tank is as straightforward an experience as you can get, and about as subtle about it as, well, a tank. You play as the last lone machine in the fight against the Iron Fleet. Dropped behind enemy lines, each run pits you against bosses in your fight to reach the Citadel and the enormous Dominator that guards it to try and end the war once and for all. ... [MORE]

title: Knight & Dragon Side Story turns the text-based JRPG from turn-based to real-time
summary: We cover a lot of smaller, more niche series on the site here. And one of them that has recently cropped up is Knight & Dragon, a text-based JRPG series full of plenty of number-crunching and grind. Now, developer Shinjiro Nakagawa is trying something new with the launch of Knight & Dragon Side Story. As you may have already gleaned from the headline, the core change of Knight & Dragon Side Story is that it ditches the traditional turn-based JRPG combat in favour of real-time action. It's not fully 3D, however, as instead you'll be tasked with actively dodging attacks in the style of something like Undertale, making for a more fast-paced adventure. ... [MORE]

title: Blackwater Mill is an ambitious, if flawed, horror game from a small Yorkshire studio
summary: It seems as though every facet of American society has been explored in horror, from the high towers of luxury to the dark backwoods. But the same is not true of other countries, including the UK, especially with so many dark, decrepit corners to explore. That's what Yorkshire bashed Wrenhaven Ltd. are looking to resolve with their upcoming mobile horror game Blackwater Mill. Blackwater Mill sees you step into the role of Sam, the project manager for the demolition of the titular mill. Venturing up into the Pennine mountains of Yorkshire during a dark, rainy night, you find yourself trapped in the mill, and it's up to you to find out what happened to leave it infested with the unquiet dead. ... [MORE]

title: Digging Deep 2 offers Motherload-style mining and exploration, out now on Android
summary: As I often say, you can trace a direct line from the world of Flash games to the popular picks on mobile today. Just take a look at Digging Deep, and you can see more than a bit of inspiration from the classic Motherload. But in Digging Deep 2: Mine & Build, developer Bitrealms Studio is going even bigger than before. Digging Deep 2's aim is simple: you have a base and a mining rig. You need to mine downwards into the shaft, navigating across each node and seeking out both ore to take back to the surface, as well as oxygen to let you dig deeper. Not to mention keeping your sensors peeled for crew members still trapped below. ... [MORE]

title: Sol Cesto, the surreal roguelike dungeon crawler, is now in early access on Android
summary: Time to step into the darkest dungeon and go rogue as you seek to cover your dark soul with light. That enough puns? Good, because Sol Cesto, the new roguelike dungeon crawler on Android, is not shy about taking you to the surreal, nightmarish end of the genre. Available to play in early access on Google Play, it's an amusing and unnerving journey to the depths. Sol Cesto tasks you with one aim: venturing into the deep, dark dungeon in pursuit of the sun that disappeared beneath the earth. You'll need to jump along rows of 'floors' and face off against the random hazards or boons in each. Along the way, you'll gain upgrades, unlock new heroes and experience the surreal, haunting atmosphere of Sol Cesto. ... [MORE]

title: Dunk City Dynasty introduces Tim Duncan to the line up in time for its holiday update
summary: As we head into the winter, the holidays are upon us. That time of year when, depending on where you live in the world and where you're from, it's Guy Fawkes Night, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's practically back-to-back. So, maybe it's time to unwind with Dunk City Dynasty as they add legendary player Tim Duncan to the roster? Tim Duncan, a five-time NBA Champion and widely known as The Big Fundamental, spent the entirety of his nearly 20-year career with the San Antonio Spurs. But don't let that fool you, because on the court Duncan will challenge you to master the fundamentals of pro basketball with footwork, defence and bank shots galore. ... [MORE]

title: Sticky Snap! is a sticky, slime-swinging puzzler coming to mobile from Ovidiu Tepes
summary: While mobile doesn't have an auteur developer on the level of something like Hideo Kojima, by now you've probably noticed there are plenty of names that crop up which we like to cover, such as Bart Bonte or solo developer Ovidiu Tepes, who has just opened the store page for his newest game, Sticky Snap! Just like Tepes' previous releases, this is a deceptively simple-looking puzzler, but one that has some truly engaging mechanics to it. You play as a slime with three sticky limbs, and have to alternate between them as you travel across levels, dodging obstacles and seeking out your gold coin as you go. ... [MORE]

title: Tiny Bookshop set to introduce Arts & Crafts DLC with even more cosy bookstore fun
summary: While cosy may be a term bordering on the pejorative nowadays, that doesn't mean there aren't plenty of cracking games out there to play in the genre. A case in point is Tiny Bookshop, a great game for any fan of literature and a good bookstore. Now, developer Neoludic Games is celebrating one million copies sold, with an all-new DLC coming soon! Arts & Crafts, the new DLC for Tiny Bookshop, is set to arrive later this month. Don't expect any massive new changes, like a roguelike dungeon-crawling mode. But you will find two new locations to visit, with the introduction of Puffin Primary and the Artist Quarter, not to mention 24 new wagon parts and 30 decoration items. ... [MORE]

title: Dicevaders lets you destroy earth with dice, out now on iOS
summary: As we head towards the weekend, it's becoming increasingly cold and dark, and that means you'll probably want to sit and find a mobile game to sink plenty of time into. Well, you're in luck, because there's a constant glut of great new releases, including the launch of Dicevaders on iOS! Dicevaders sees you taking on the role not of defender of the Earth, but of its invaders and destroyers. To do so, you'll need to gradually overwhelm the defences of each of Earth's bastions, and you'll do so with dice (naturally). In essence, you place units, build up multipliers and gradually overcome the defence rating of each planet to destroy it. ... [MORE]

title: Hitman World of Assassination's latest elusive target mission features Lenny Kravitz's Bawma
summary: Hitman World of Assassination is getting a brand-new elusive target. Available to play on iOS, Hitman World of Assassination offers plenty of opportunities for murderous mischief in exotic locations. And, starting today, the latest celebrity face to get embroiled in the action is none other than rock star Lenny Kravitz! Lenny Kravitz stars as Bawma, the pirate king who serves as the central antagonist of 007 First Light, another IO Interactive game. Of course, given he has to survive to face down Bond, Bawma is not the actual target here. Instead, Agent 47 is tasked with eliminating three rogue lieutenants under Bawma's watchful gaze on Ambrose Island. The mission is available to play until December 24th. ... [MORE]

title: Azur Promilia, Manju Games' creature-collecting RPG, is out now in Korea
summary: Nexon and Manju Games today bring one of their latest, greatest multiplayer RPG projects to Korea. Now, players in South Korea will be able to get their hands on the creature-collecting RPG Azur Promilia. And it could also turn out to be good news for fans in the West. Azur Promilia follows a similar formula to Roco Kingdom and Honkai Nexus Anima, seeing you explore a vast fantasy world and recruit cute critters called Kibo to your side. These Kibo not only assist you in battle, but also help you explore by using their abilities during traversal. All this is wrapped around by quite gorgeous graphics and anime-style character designs, for a pretty solid RPG world to explore. ... [MORE]

title: Escape the Baby Alarm is a humorous, heartfelt game about young motherhood, out now
summary: Let's be honest, most of us aren't prepared for parenthood. I find myself constantly shocked and surprised at how many of my peers have already started families, as the idea utterly terrifies me. But if anything gives an honest, heartwarming, humorous look into the experience, it's Escape the Baby Alarm. This hand-drawn puzzler from Danish developer Julie Normann Bjørnskov boasts a fully illustrated look also created by Bjørnskov. Charting the experiences of a young mother, it fuses puzzle gameplay with comedic interludes as the surreal, stressful nature of raising a child takes hold. Boasting 17 chapters and 38 puzzles, there's plenty there to explore in Escape the Baby Alarm. ... [MORE]

title: Fishing Inc is Snapbreak's newest release for the fishing fanatics out there, now on iOS and Android
summary: Need to cast your reel? Don't have a fishing spot nearby? Well, then you're in luck because developer Snapbreak have just released their latest mobile game, and this time it's BigBonk Studios and their exciting new incremental fishing game, Fishing Inc, that's out now on iOS and Android! In Fishing Inc, you, well, fish. No surprises there. But what sets it apart is the depth of content here, letting you fish for a huge variety of species with their own distinct behaviour, including legendary catches, all while travelling to different locations from small fishing holes to the vast blue ocean. You'll also have access to upgrades as you work your way up to bigger and better catches all across the world! ... [MORE]
